title: Selling Plans — Moving a Store from the Annual to the Monthly Term
content:
## Policy

A store held on the annual term may move to the monthly term of the same plan before its annual term ends; the move is the seller's own decision, it takes effect at the plan's downgrade effective point, and because the annual-term saving was given in return for the whole term, a term change fee is billed on the move.

This applies to every store plan of **Selling Plans** that offers both terms. The result the policy governs is the term change fee billed on the move; the observable effect is the plan shown on the monthly term and the fee listed among the plan's fees.

## When the fee is worked out

The term change fee is not worked out until every chargeback debited to the seller's payments account in the last twelve months carries its chargeback credit on the order's variable final value fee record.

The term change fee is worked out only after every order the seller cancelled before shipment in the last twelve months carries its cancellation credit on the order's variable final value fee record.

Read against the records, both clauses describe a state the fee waits on:

| Record looked at, last twelve months | State the fee waits on |
|---|---|
| Each chargeback debited to the seller's payments account | The order's variable final value fee record carries its chargeback credit |
| Each order the seller cancelled before shipment | The order's variable final value fee record carries its cancellation credit |

## Self-service tool: `switch_store_to_monthly_term_ae40bf8f`

**Capability.** Moves a store from the annual billing term to the monthly billing term of the same plan. The plan's billing term becomes monthly, the monthly term is recorded as starting on the plan's next billing date (the annual term end date is cleared), and one term change fee is billed on the plan as an early termination fee record carrying the number of billing dates that were still to come in the annual term. The seller sees the plan on the monthly term and the fee listed among the plan's fees, dated today.

**How it is invoked.** This is the seller's own tool. The agent unlocks `switch_store_to_monthly_term_ae40bf8f` and hands it over; the customer themselves runs it on their own selling plan, which is how the seller confirms the move.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `selling_plan_id` | The reference number of the seller's own selling plan, as returned by the selling plan lookup | Id |
| `term_change_fee` | The term change fee billed on the move | USD, a non-negative amount to 2 decimal places, rounded to the nearest cent |

**Return.** A receipt listing `fee_id` (the fee reference of the new fee record), `selling_plan_id`, `billing_term` (always "monthly"), `term_start_date` (YYYY-MM-DD, the date the monthly term starts), `remaining_term_months` (integer, the billing dates that were still to come in the annual term), `term_change_fee` (USD to 2 decimal places) and `event_date` (YYYY-MM-DD, the billing date). A receipt carrying a `fee_id` means the move is recorded and the fee is billed.
